name: DeepSeek Harness for Win v1.0.5
body:
## Features / 主要更新

- Portable updates now download and verify inside the desktop app with visible progress before asking to restart. / 便携版更新现在会在桌面应用内下载并校验，显示进度后再询问是否重启。
- A verified update package can wait safely until the user confirms the restart and runtime replacement. / 已校验的更新包会安全等待，直到用户确认重启并替换运行时。

## Improvements / 优化提升

- Update metadata follows HTTP redirects and races the direct GitHub endpoint with several mirror sources. / 更新元数据支持跟随 HTTP 重定向，并在 GitHub 直连与多个镜像源之间快速竞速。
- The updater receives the prepared local package instead of downloading the same release a second time. / 更新器直接接收已准备好的本地更新包，不再重复下载同一个 release。
- Standalone updates use shorter network timeouts, multiple mirror fallbacks, and honor an explicit target version. / 独立运行更新脚本使用更短的网络超时、多个镜像兜底，并遵循显式目标版本。

## Fixes / 修复

- Stable releases no longer compare below prerelease tags such as rc versions. / 正式版本不再被错误判断为低于 rc 等预发布版本。
- API fallback no longer repeats the full checksum lookup for every mirror response. / API 备用节点失败时不再对每个节点重复完整的校验和查询。
